info.title: AgentTools API
info.description:
## 🤖 AgentTools — High-Value Tool APIs for Agentic AI Systems

A production-grade platform providing powerful, ready-to-use tools for AI agents,
compatible with **OpenAI function calling**, **Claude tool use**, **LangChain**, **CrewAI**,
and any framework that can make HTTP requests.

### 🛠️ Core Agentic Tools

| Tool | Endpoint | Description |
|------|----------|-------------|
| 🧾 Invoice & Receipt Intelligence | `POST /tools/invoice-extract` | Extract structured JSON (vendor, line items, totals, dates, math verify) |
| 📄 PDF & Document Intelligence | `POST /tools/pdf-extract` | Extract structured pages, metadata, outlines & token counts from PDFs |
| 🌐 Markdown Web Scraper | `POST /tools/web-reader` | Clean HTML & convert pages to LLM-optimized Markdown with token counts |
| 🔍 Web Search | `POST /tools/web-search` | Search the web via DuckDuckGo with structured snippets |
| 📰 News Intelligence | `POST /tools/news` | Real-time news headlines & summaries by topic |
| 📝 Text Summarizer | `POST /tools/summarize` | Fast extractive text summarization |
| ☁️ Weather | `POST /tools/weather` | Global real-time weather + forecasts |
| 🧮 Safe Calculator | `POST /tools/calculator` | Safe mathematical expression evaluator |
| 🌍 IP Info | `GET /tools/ip-info` | IP geolocation & network metadata |

### 🔑 Authentication
Pass your API key in the **`X-API-Key`** header.
RapidAPI users can use the **`X-RapidAPI-Key`** header automatically.

### 📊 Rate Limits
| Tier | Daily Calls | Rate |
|------|-------------|------|
| Free | 100/day | Standard |
| Pro | 10,000/day | Standard |
| Enterprise | Unlimited | Priority |

get.description: Returns server health status. No authentication required.
Returns current API key usage stats including daily and total call counts.

post.summary: Extract structured data from invoices and receipts
post.description: Parses PDF, image, or raw text invoices/receipts into rigid structured JSON: vendor name, invoice number, PO number, dates, currency, line items table, subtotal, tax amount, total amount, and automatic math verification. Built for accounting AI agents.

post.summary: Extract text and metadata from PDF
post.description: Downloads or decodes a PDF document and extracts structured text per page, document metadata (title, author), total page count, document outlines, and estimated LLM token count. Designed specifically for AI agent document ingestion.

post.summary: Scrape and convert webpage to Markdown
post.description: Fetches any public URL and converts the main content into clean, structured Markdown. Strips navigation bars, cookie banners, tracking scripts, and ads while preserving headers, tables, lists, and code blocks. Includes word count and estimated LLM token count.
Searches the web using DuckDuckGo and returns structured results (title, URL, snippet). No API key required for the underlying search engine.
Returns current weather conditions and a multi-day forecast for any location worldwide. Powered by Open-Meteo (free, no API key required). Supports any city name, region, or country.

Safely evaluates mathematical expressions using AST parsing (no `eval()`). Supports arithmetic, exponents, modulo, trigonometry (sin, cos, tan), logarithms (log, log2, log10), sqrt, factorial, and constants (pi, e, tau).
Fetches the latest news headlines and summaries for any topic using Google News RSS. Returns clean article titles, sources, publication dates, URLs, and snippet text.

Extracts the most important sentences from any long text using frequency-based sentence scoring. Zero-cost — runs on-server with no external LLM API fees. Returns summary, sentence count, and compression ratio.

get.description: Looks up geolocation data for an IP address or the requesting client. Returns city, region, country, coordinates, timezone, and ISP information.
